## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Related to [HKUDS/nanobot](https://github.com/HKUDS/nanobot) / 与 nanobot 相关
- [ ] Link is live and canonical (no redirects/mirrors) / 链接有效且指向规范仓库
- [ ] Both `README.md` and `README_CN.md` updated / 两个 README 都已更新
- [ ] Table format matches existing rows: `| [Name](url) | ⭐ N | Status | Description |` / 表格格式与现有行一致
- [ ] Same-name projects disambiguated with author suffix / 同名项目已用作者后缀消歧
- [ ] Description is factual, no marketing fluff / 描述客观，无营销话术
